title: MaleTheme Duo #010 · 남 V자 보디빌더·라이트 스모키·군인 테마 / 남 머슬 모델·플럼 스모키·경찰관 테마·투톤
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright tropical jungle boardwalk of wooden planks with a waist-high rope rail, large green leaves and standard-height steps, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Uzbek man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a fresh-faced boy-group idol face with clear glowing skin, bright eyes and a gentle smile line, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a shy sweet smile, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in curly, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a tin teardrop-shaped sinker, a tin miniature anvil, a lead pyramid-shaped lump, a gold small flared temple bell, a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver rings. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge, two silver dog-tag chains hanging on his bare chest, and a minimal camouflage-pattern T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme olive-green cowboy boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Spanish man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth warm olive skin, a confident smirk, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a copper teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold anklets. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black police cap with a silver badge, a thin black leather chest harness carrying a silver badge, steel handcuffs hanging from one hip string, and a minimal black and white two-tone leather T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme silver platform stiletto knee-high boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
